title: The Gavel's Echo
setting_summary: In the cramped, heavily monitored tribunal of a besieged border city, five legal professionals must adjudicate a case that tests the limits of dignity, free expression, and the right to life under a state of emergency. The courtroom's tight security and the looming threat of external violence create a pressure cooker where every testimony and objection carries life-or-death consequences. As the trial unfolds, each article of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights becomes a battleground for ethical conflict and personal sacrifice.
